description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Vladimir''' spreads a virulent plague at the target location that infects enemies hit for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 10%.
description.text: Active: Vladimir spreads a virulent plague at the target location that infects enemies hit for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 10%.

description2.raw: After the duration, the infection bursts to deal magic damage to all affected targets and, after a 0.4-second delay, [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heal]] '''Vladimir''' for each infected champion, reduced to 40% for champions beyond the first.
description2.text: After the duration, the infection bursts to deal magic damage to all affected targets and, after a 0.4-second delay, heal Vladimir for each infected champion, reduced to 40% for champions beyond the first.

notes.raw: * ''Hemoplague'' will amplify almost all sources and types of damage, even including damage from neutral monsters. ** [[File:Hybrid penetration icon.png|15px|link=True damage]] True damage will however not be amplified.(bug) ** ''Hemoplague's'' effect [[File:Multiple stacking icon.png|20px|link=Stacking#Stacks_multiplicatively|An icon representing the keyword Stacks multiplicatively]] [[:Stacking#Stacks_multiplicatively|stacks multiplicatively]] with other damage modifiers. ** ''Hemoplague'' amplifies itself for an actual damage of 165 / 220 / 275 / 330 / 385 (+ 77% AP). * ''Hemoplague's'' modifier to incoming damage stacks additively with [[File:Alistar OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Alistar|An icon representing Alistar]] [[Alistar|Alistar's]] [[File:Alistar Unbreakable Will.png|20xpx|border|link=Alistar#Unbreakable Will|An icon for Alistar's ability Unbreakable Will]] [[Alistar#Unbreakable Will|Unbreakable Will]] for a total damage reduction of 45 / 55 / 65%.(unexpected) * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] does not negate the detonation.
notes.text:
Hemoplague will amplify almost all sources and types of damage, even including damage from neutral monsters.
*  True damage will however not be amplified.(bug)
* Hemoplague's effect stacks multiplicatively with other damage modifiers.
* Hemoplague amplifies itself for an actual damage of 165 / 220 / 275 / 330 / 385 (+ 77% AP).
Hemoplague's modifier to incoming damage stacks additively with Alistar's Unbreakable Will for a total damage reduction of 45 / 55 / 65%.(unexpected)
Spell shield does not negate the detonation.
